title: EMBER interval-average PM2.5 observation v1
description: UTC timestamps required. PM2.5 is the measured average over [sample_start_utc, sample_end_utc). A 1 s sensor cadence and 10 s aggregation window are design targets, not verified hardware capabilities. Never fill missing values with zero. session_id is added by the gateway per deployment/shift. Runtime also validates ordering, interval overlap, finite numeric values, and timing against the evaluation clock.

session_id.description: Gateway-issued ID for one work session. Do not reuse across shifts.

pm25_ug_m3.description: Observed interval average in micrograms per cubic metre. null = no usable measurement.

source.description: Preserve source provenance. A public-dataset replay is not a live firefighter measurement.

received_at_utc.description: Gateway receipt time; never substitute this for collection time.

symptoms.description: Optional manual report codes. request_help/confusion/loss_of_consciousness latch urgent assistance. The pipeline still detects a recognized urgent string in a malformed mixed-type list.
